The '''All-Terrain Exploration Droid (AT-ED)''' was a model of [[Explorer droid/Legends|exploration droid]] developed in collaboration between [[Cybot Galactica/Legends|Cybot Galactica]] and [[Kuat Drive Yards/Legends|Kuat Drive Yards]], designed to assist in the exploration and surveying of newly discovered [[Planet/Legends|planets]].<ref name="Enter the Unknown" />

==Characteristics==
The [[Walker/Legends|walker]] appeared similar to the [[AT-series/Legends|All Terrain]] [[All Terrain Scout Transport/Legends|Scout Transport]] or the [[All Terrain Personal Transport/Legends|All Terrain Personal Transport]], though it lacked the chin-mounted [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]]. It had a single side-mounted heavy blaster for armament. It was two and a half [[Meter/Legends|meters]] tall.<ref name="Enter the Unknown" />

It had good balance and easily traversed rough terrain. Its chassis was full of antennae, microphones, [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptors]], and sensors which could make detailed maps [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]] into the distance or up to fifty meters of rock. Their complex systems were difficult to maintain and expensive. Despite the high cost of AT-EDs, and their sometimes standoffish personalities, AT-EDs were very popular in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="Enter the Unknown" />

==Behind the scenes==
The All-Terrain Exploration Droid was first mentioned in ''[[Enter the Unknown]]'', a sourcebook written by [[Sterling Hershey]] for ''[[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire]]''.<ref name="Enter the Unknown" />
